dn31:1.2: Ekaṃ samayaṃ Bhagavā Rājagahe viharati Veḷu-vane Kalandaka-nivāpe.
dn31:1.3: Tena kho pana samayena Siṅgālako gahapati-putto kālass' eva vuṭṭhāya, Rājagahā nikkhamitvā, alla-vattho alla-keso pañjaliko puthud Disā namassati
dn31:1.4: puratthimaṃ Disaṃ dakkhiṇaṃ Disaṃ pacchimaṃ Disaṃ uttaraṃ Disaṃ heṭṭhimam Disaṃ uparimaṃ Disaṃ. 2.
dn31:2.1: Atha kho Bhagavā pubbaṇha-samayaṃ nivāsetvā patta-cīvaram ādāya Rājagahaṃ piṇḍāya pāvisi.
dn31:2.2: Addasā kho Bhagavā Siṅgālakaṃ gahapati-puttaṃ kālass' eva vuṭṭhāya Rājagahā nikkhamitvā alla-vatthaṃ alla-kesaṃ pañjalikaṃ puthuddisā namassantaṃ
dn31:2.3: puratthimaṃ disaṃ dakkhiṇaṃ disaṃ pacchimaṃ disaṃ uttaraṃ disaṃ heṭṭhimaṃ disaṃ uparimaṃ disaṃ.
dn31:2.5: ‘Kin nu tvaṃ gahapati-putta kālass' eva vuṭṭhāya Rājagahā nikkhamitvā alla-vattho alla-keso pañjaliko puthuddisā namassasi
dn31:2.6: puratthimaṃ disaṃ . . . pe . . . uparimaṃ disan ti?'
dn31:2.9: So kho ahaṃ bhante pitu vacanaṃ sakkaronto garukaronto mānento pūjento kālass' eva vuṭṭhāya Rājagahā nikkhamitvā alla-vattho alla-keso pañjaliko puthuddisā namassāmi
dn31:2.10: puratthimaṃ disaṃ . . . pe . . . uparimaṃ disan ti.'
dn31:2.12: ‘Na kho gahapati-putta Ariyassa vinaye evaṃ chaddisā namassitabbā ti.'
dn31:2.13: ‘Yathā kathaṃ pana bhante Ariyassa vinaye chaddisā namassitabbā?
dn31:2.14: Sādhu me bhante Bhagavā tathā dhammaṃ desetu yathā Ariyassa vinaye chaddisā namassitabbā ti.'
dn31:2.15: ‘Tena hi gahapati-putta suṇāhi sādhukaṃ manasikarohi, bhāsissāmīti.'
dn31:2.16: ‘Evam bhante ti' kho Siṅgālako gahapati-putto Bhagavato paccassosi.
dn31:3.1: ‘Yato kho gahapati-putta ariya-sāvakassa cattāro kamma-kilesā pahīnā honti, catūhi ca ṭhānehi pāpakammaṃ na karoti, cha ca bhogānaṃ apāya-mukhāni na sevati, so evaṃ cuddasa pāpakā 'pagato, chaddisā paṭicchādī,
dn31:3.2: ubho-loka-vijayāya paṭipanno hoti, tassa ayañ c' eva loko āraddho hoti paro ca loko.
dn31:3.3: Kāyassa bhedā param maraṇā sugatiṃ saggaṃ lokaṃ uppajjati. ‘Katam' assa
dn31:3.6: Pāṇātipāto kho gahapati-putta kamma-kileso, adinnādānaṃ kamma-kileso, kāmesu micchācāro kamma-kileso, musāvādo kamma-kileso.
dn31:3.9: Idaṃ vatvā Sugato, athāparaṃ etad avoca Satthā:
dn31:5.2: Chandāgatiṃ gacchanto pāpa-kammaṃ karoti, dosāgatiṃ gacchanto pāpa-kammaṃ karoti, mohāgatiṃ gacchanto pāpa-kammaṃ karoti, bhayāgatiṃ gacchanto pāpa-kammaṃ karoti.
dn31:5.3: Yato kho gahapati-putta Ariya-sāvako n' eva chandāgatiṃ gacchati, na dosagatiṃ gacchati, na mohāgatiṃ gacchati, na bhayāgatiṃ gacchati,
dn31:5.4: imehi catūhi ṭhānehi pāpa-kammaṃ na karotīti.'
dn31:5.6: Idaṃ vatvā Sugato athāparaṃ etad avoca Satthā.
dn31:7.2: Surā-meraya-majja-pamāda-ṭṭhānānuyogo kho gahapatiputta bhogānaṃ apāya-mukhaṃ. Vikāla-visikhā-cariyānuyogo bhogānaṃ apāya-mukhaṃ. Samajjābhicaraṇaṃ bhogānaṃ apāya-mukhaṃ. Jūta-ppamāda-ṭṭhānānuyogo bhogānaṃ apāya-mukhaṃ. Pāpa-mittānuyogo bhogānaṃ apāya-mukhaṃ. Ālassānuyogo bhogānaṃ apāya-mukhaṃ. 8.
dn31:8.2: sandiṭṭhikā dhanañjāni, kalaha-ppavaḍḍhanī, rogānaṃ āyatanaṃ, akitti-sañjananī, kopīna-niddaṃsanī, paññāya dubbalī-karaṇī tv eva chaṭṭhaṃ padaṃ bhavati.
dn31:8.3: Ime kho gahapati-putta cha ādīnavā surā-meraya-majja-pamāda-ṭṭhānānuyogo. 9.
dn31:9.2: attā pi 'ssa agutto arakkhito hoti, putta-dāro pi 'ssa agutto arakkhito hoti, sāpateyyam pi 'ssa aguttaṃ arakkhitaṃ hoti, saṃkiyo ca hoti pāpakesu ṭhānesu, abhūtaṃ vacanañ ca tasmiṃ rūhati, bahunnañ ca dukkha-dhammānaṃ purakkhato hoti.
dn31:9.3: Ime kho gahapatiputta cha ādīnavā vikāla-visikhā-cariyānuyoge. 10.
dn31:10.2: "Kuvaṃ naccaṃ, kuvaṃ gītaṃ, kuvaṃ vāditaṃ, kuvaṃ akkhānaṃ, kuvaṃ pānissaraṃ, kuvaṃ kumbhathūnan ti?"
dn31:10.3: Ime kho gahapati-putta cha ādīnavā samajjābhicaraṇe. 11.
dn31:11.2: jayaṃ veraṃ pasavati, jino vittam anusocati, sandiṭṭhikā dhanañjāni, sabhā-gatassa vacanaṃ na rūhati, mittāmaccānaṃ paribhūto hoti, āvāha-vivāhakānaṃ apatthito hoti,
dn31:11.4: Ime kho gahapati-putta cha ādīnavā jūtappamāda-ṭṭhānānuyoge. 12.
dn31:12.2: ye dhuttā, ye soṇḍā, ye pipāsā, ye nekatikā, ye vañcanikā, ye sāhasikā, tyāssa mittā honti, te sahāyā.
dn31:12.3: Ime kho gahapati-putta cha ādīnavā pāpa-mittānuyoge. 13.
dn31:13.2: "Ati-sītan ti" kammaṃ na karoti, "Ati-uṇhan ti" kammaṃ na karoti, "Ati-sāyan ti" kammaṃ na karoti, "Atipāto ti" kammaṃ na karoti, "Ati-chāto 'smīti" kammaṃ na karoti, "Ati-dhāto 'smīti" kammaṃ na karoti.
dn31:13.3: Tassa evaṃ kiccāpadesa-bahulassa viharato anuppannā c' eva bhogā n' uppajjanti, uppannā ca bhogā parikkhayaṃ gacchanti.
dn31:13.4: Ime kho gahapati-putta cha ādīnavā ālassānuyoge ti.'
dn31:13.6: Idaṃ vatvā Sugato athāparaṃ etad avoca Satthā:
dn31:14.33: Yo ca sītañ ca uṇhañ ca
dn31:15.2: Aññadatthu-haro amitto mitta-paṭirūpako veditabbo: vacī-paramo amitto mitta-paṭirūpako veditabbo: anuppiya-bhāṇī amitto mitta-paṭirūpako veditabbo: apāyasahāyo amitto mitta-paṭirūpako veditabbo. 16.
dn31:16.1: ‘Catūhi kho gahapati-putta ṭhānehi aññadatthu-haro amitto mitta-paṭirūpako veditabbo.
dn31:16.6: Imehi kho gahapati-putta catūhi ṭhānehi aññadatthu-haro amitto mitta-paṭirūpako veditabbo. 17.
dn31:17.1: ‘Catūhi kho gahapati-putta ṭhānehi vacī-paramo amitto mitta-paṭirūpako veditabbo.
dn31:17.2: Atītena paṭisantharati: anāgatena paṭisantharati: niratthakena saṅgaṇhāti: paccuppannesu kiccesu vyasanaṃ dasseti.
dn31:17.3: Imehi kho gahapatiputta catūhi ṭhānehi vacī-paramo amitto mitta-paṭirūpako veditabbo. 18.
dn31:18.1: ‘Catūhi kho gahapati-putta ṭhānehi anuppiya-bhāṇī amitto mitta-paṭirūpako veditabbo.
dn31:18.2: Pāpakam pi 'ssa anujānāti: kalyāṇam pi 'ssa nānujānāti: sammukhā 'ssa vaṇṇaṃ bhāsati: parammukhā 'ssa avaṇṇaṃ bhāsati.
dn31:18.3: Imehi kho gahapati-putta catūhi ṭhānehi anuppiya-bhāṇī amitto mitta-paṭirūpako veditabbo. 19.
dn31:19.1: ‘Catūhi kho gahapati-putta ṭhānehi apāya-sahāyo amitto mitta-paṭirūpako veditabbo.
dn31:19.2: Surā-meraya-majjapamāda-ṭṭhānānuyoge sahāyo hoti: vikāla-visikhā-cariyānuyoge sahāyo hoti: samajjābhicaraṇe sahāyo hoti: jūtappamāda-ṭṭhānānuyoge sahāyo hoti.
dn31:19.3: Imehi kho gahapatiputta catūhi ṭhānehi apāya-sahāyo amitto mitta-paṭirūpako veditabbo ti.
dn31:19.5: Idaṃ vatvā Sugato, athāparaṃ etad avoca Satthā: ‘
dn31:21.2: Upakāro mitto suhado veditabbo: samāna-sukha-dukkho mitto suhado veditabbo: atth-akkhāyī mitto suhado veditabbo: anukampako mitto suhado veditabbo. 22.
dn31:22.1: ‘Catūhi kho gahapati-putta ṭhānehi upakāro mitto suhado veditabbo.
dn31:22.2: Pamattaṃ rakkhati: pamattassa sāpateyyaṃ rakkhati: bhītassa saraṇaṃ hoti: uppannesu kicca-karaṇīyesu tad diguṇaṃ bhogaṃ anuppādeti.
dn31:22.3: Imehi kho gahapati-putta catūhi ṭhānehi upakāro mitto suhado veditabbo. 23.
dn31:23.1: ‘Catūhi kho gahapati-putta ṭhānehi samāna-sukhadukkho mitto suhado veditabbo.
dn31:23.2: Guyham assa ācikkhati: guyham assa parigūhati: āpadāsu na vijahati: jīvitam pi 'ssa atthāya pariccattaṃ hoti.
dn31:23.3: Imehi kho gahapati-putta catūhi ṭhānehi samāna-sukha-dukkho mitto suhado veditabbo. 24.
dn31:24.1: ‘Catūhi kho gahapati-putta ṭhānehi atth-akkhāyī mitto suhado veditabbo.
dn31:24.2: Pāpā nivāreti: kalyāṇe niveseti: assutaṃ sāveti: saggassa maggaṃ ācikkhati.
dn31:24.3: Imehi kho gahapati-putta catūhi ṭhānehi atth-akkhāyī mitto suhado veditabbo. 25.
dn31:25.1: ‘Catūhi kho gahapati-putta ṭhānehi anukampako mitto suhado veditabbo.
dn31:25.2: Abhaven' assa na nandati: bhaven' assa nandati: avaṇṇaṃ bhaṇamānaṃ nivāreti: vaṇṇaṃ bhaṇamānaṃ pasaṃsati.
dn31:25.3: Imehi kho gahapatiputta catūhi ṭhānehi anukampako mitto suhado veditabbo ti.'
dn31:25.5: Idaṃ vatvā Sugato, athāparaṃ etad avoca Satthā:
dn31:26.1: ‘Upakāro ca yo mitto, 1 yo ca mitto
dn31:27.1: ‘Kathañ ca gahapati-putta ariya-sāvako chaddisā paṭicchādī hoti?
dn31:27.3: Puratthimā disā mātā-pitaro veditabbā. Dakkhiṇā disā ācariyā veditabbā. Pacchimā disā puttadārā veditabbā. Uttarā disā mittāmaccā veditabbā. Heṭṭhimā disā dāsa-kammakarā porisā veditabbā. Uparimā disā Samaṇa-Brāhmaṇā veditabbā. 28.
dn31:28.1: ‘Pañcahi kho gahapati-putta ṭhānehi puttena puratthimā disā mātā-pitaro paccupaṭṭhātabbā.
dn31:28.2: "Bhato nesaṃ bharissāmi, kiccaṃ nesaṃ karissāmi, kula-vaṃsaṃ ṭhapessāmi, dāyajjam paṭipajjāmi, atha ca pana petānaṃ kālakatānaṃ dakkhiṇaṃ anuppadassāmīti."
dn31:28.3: Imehi kho gahapati-putta pañcahi ṭhānehi puttena puratthimā disā mātāpitaro paccupaṭṭhitā pañcahi ṭhānehi puttaṃ anukampanti.
dn31:28.4: Pāpā nivārenti, kalyāṇe nivesenti, sippaṃ sikkhāpenti, paṭirūpena dārena saṃyojenti, samaye dāyajjaṃ niyyādenti.
dn31:28.5: Imehi kho gahapati-putta pañcahi ṭhānehi puttena puratthimā disā mātā-pitaro paccupaṭṭhitā imehi pañcahi ṭhānehi puttaṃ anukampanti.
dn31:28.6: Evam assa esā puratthimā disā paṭicchannā hoti khemā appaṭibhayā. 29.
dn31:29.1: ‘Pañcahi kho gahapati-putta ṭhānehi antevāsinā dakkhiṇā disā ācariyā paccupaṭṭhātabbā:
dn31:29.2: uṭṭhānena, upaṭṭhānena, sussūsāya, pāricariyāya, sakkaccaṃ sippa-paṭiggahaṇena.
dn31:29.3: Imehi kho gahapati-putta pañcahi ṭhānehi antevāsinā dakkhiṇā disā ācariyā paccupaṭṭhitā pañcahi ṭhānehi antevāsiṃ anukampanti.
dn31:29.4: Suvinītaṃ vinenti, suggahitaṃ gāhāpenti, sabba-sippa-sutaṃ samakkhāyino bhavanti, mittāmaccesu parivedenti, disāsu parittānaṃ karonti.
dn31:29.5: Imehi kho gahapati-putta pañcahi ṭhānehi ante vāsinā dakkhiṇā disā ācariyā paccupaṭṭhitā imehi pañcahi ṭhānehi antevāsiṃ anukampanti.
dn31:29.6: Evam assa esā dakkhiṇā disā paṭicchannā hoti khemā appaṭibhayā. 30.
dn31:30.1: ‘Pañcahi kho gahapati-putta ṭhānehi sāmikena pacchimā disā bhariyā paccupaṭṭhātabbā:
dn31:30.3: Imehi kho gahapati-putta pañcahi ṭhānehi sāmikena pacchimā disā bhariyā paccupaṭṭhitā pañcahi ṭhānehi sāmikaṃ anukampati.
dn31:30.4: Susaṃvihita-kammantā ca hoti, susaṅgahita-parijanā ca, anaticārinī ca, sambhataṃ anurakkhati, dakkhā ca hoti analasā sabbakiccesu.
dn31:30.5: Imehi kho gahapati-putta pañcahi ṭhānehi sāmikena pacchimā disā bhariyā paccupaṭṭhitā imehi pañcahi ṭhānehi sāmikaṃ anukampati.
dn31:30.6: Evam assa esā pacchimā disā paṭicchannā hoti khemā appaṭibhayā. 31.
dn31:31.1: ‘Pañcahi kho gahapati-putta ṭhānehi kula-puttena uttarā disā mittāmaccā paccupaṭṭhātabbā:
dn31:31.3: Imehi kho gahapati-putta pañcahi ṭhānehi kula-puttena uttarā disā mittāmaccā paccupaṭṭhitā pañcahi ṭhānehi kulaputtaṃ anukampanti.
dn31:31.4: Pamattaṃ rakkhanti, pamattassa sāpateyyaṃ rakkhanti, bhītassa saraṇaṃ honti, āpadāsu na vijahanti, apara-pajaṃ ca pi 'ssa paṭipūjenti.
dn31:31.5: Imehi kho gahapati-putta pañcahi ṭhānehi kula-puttena uttarā disā mittāmaccā paccupaṭṭhitā imehi pañcahi ṭhānehi kulaputtaṃ anukampanti.
dn31:31.6: Evam assa esā uttarā disā paṭicchannā hoti khemā appaṭibhayā. 32.
dn31:32.1: ‘Pañcahi kho gahapati-putta ṭhānehi ayirakena heṭṭhimā disā dāsa-kammakarā paccupaṭṭhātabbā:
dn31:32.2: yathābalaṃ kammanta-saṃvidhānena, bhatta-vettanānuppadānena, gilānupaṭṭhānena , acchariyānaṃ rasānaṃ saṃvibhāgena, samaye vossaggena.
dn31:32.3: Imehi kho gahapati-putta pañcahi ṭhānehi ayirakena heṭṭhimā disā dāsa-kammakarā paccupaṭṭhitā pañcahi ṭhānehi ayirakaṃ anukampanti.
dn31:32.4: Pubbuṭṭhāyino ca honti, pacchā-nipātino ca, dinna-dāyino ca, sukata-kamma-kārakā, kitti-vaṇṇa-harā ca.
dn31:32.5: Imehi kho gahapati-putta pañcahi ṭhānehi ayirakena heṭṭhimā disā dāsa-kammakarā paccupaṭṭhitā imehi pañcahi ṭhānehi ayirakaṃ anukampanti.
dn31:32.6: Evam assa esā heṭṭhimā disā paṭicchannā hoti khemā appaṭibhayā. 33.
dn31:33.1: ‘Pañcahi kho gahapati-putta ṭhānehi kala-puttena uparimā disā Samaṇa-Brāhmaṇā paccupaṭṭhātabbā:
dn31:33.2: mettena kāya-kammena, mettena vacī-kammena, mettena mano-kammena, anāvaṭa-dvāratāya āmisānuppadānena.
dn31:33.3: Imehi kho gahapati-putta pañcahi ṭhānehi kula-puttena uparimā disā Samaṇa-Brāhmaṇā paccupaṭṭhitā chahi ṭhānehi kula-puttaṃ anukampanti.
dn31:33.4: Pāpā nivārenti, kalyāṇe nivesenti, kalyāṇa-manasā anukampanti, assutaṃ sāventi, sutaṃ pariyodapenti, saggassa maggam ācikkhanti .
dn31:33.5: Imehi kho gahapati-putta pañcahi ṭhānehi kula-puttena uparimā disā Samaṇa-Brāhmaṇā paccupaṭṭhitā imehi chahi ṭhānehi kula-puttaṃ anukampanti.
dn31:33.6: Evam assa esā uparimā disā paṭicchannā hoti khemā appaṭibhayā ti.'
dn31:33.8: Idaṃ vatvā Sugato, athāparaṃ etad avoca Satthā:
dn31:35.1: Evaṃ vutte Siṅgālako gahapati-putto Bhagavantaṃ etad avoca:
dn31:35.3: Seyyathā pi bhante nikkujjitaṃ vā ukkujjeyya, paṭicchannaṃ vā vivareyya, mūḷhassa vā maggaṃ ācikkheyya, andha-kāre vā tela-pajjotaṃ dhāreyya "Cakkhumanto rūpāni dakkhintīti": evam evaṃ Bhagavatā aneka-pariyāyena dhammo pakāsito.
dn31:35.4: Esāhaṃ bhante Bhagavantaṃ saraṇaṃ gacchāmi, Dhammañ ca bhikkhu-Saṃghañ ca.
dn31:35.5: Upāsakaṃ maṃ Bhagavā dhāretu ajjatagge pāṇupetaṃ saraṇaṃ gatan ti.'
